title: Don't waste time installing
body: I'd buy full version if free one showed me more capabilities and flexibilities it offers, due to not being able to, I won't invest a dime. 3 habits only as free? This is a joke.
author: Nick_83shroom

title: Annoying advertising
body: So, since implementing the subscription model, the app keeps pestering me to subscribe at least once a day. This is becoming a bit to much. I do not want the extra functions you get after subscribing and I get reminded of that every time I want to use the app. Disappointed in the direction the developer is taking this app in. Am already look for a replacement.
author: Tmarkelj

title: Please give me back my purchased version
body:
Hello, 

I would like to know what is going on. I have purchased your app 2 days ago. I opened it a few minutes ago and saw that my dark mode and the whole premium version is gone. I also got bombarded with some annual offer. I would like to have my already paid premium version back please.

Thank you
author: ThankfulStudent6969
